UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$b='{{$FullBaseDir}}'; foreach($d in 'game','content\Maps','content\Game Modes','content\Mods','playlists','data'){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Join-Path $b $d) | Out-Null }; $u=New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false); $bans=Join-Path $b 'bans.json'; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $bans)){ [IO.File]::WriteAllText($bans,'{ \"players\": [], \"ips\": [] }',$u) }; function Q($s){ $q=[string][char]34; $bs=[string][char]92; $q + $s.Replace($bs,$bs+$bs).Replace($q,$bs+$q) + $q }; $admins=(('{{Admins}}'.Split(',') | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -match '^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$' } | ForEach-Object { Q $_ }) -join ', '); $pl='{{PlaylistFile}}'.Trim(); if($pl){ $pick=@('playlist = ' + (Q $pl)) } else { $pick=@(('map = ' + (Q '{{MapName}}')), ('game = ' + (Q '{{GameType}}'))) }; $st='\"off\"'; if('{{StatsReporting}}' -eq 'true'){ $st='\"\"' }; $t=@('game = \"game\"','content = \"content\"','data = \"data\"','bans = \"bans.json\"',('public_address = ' + (Q '{{PublicAddress}}')),'upnp = false','auto_update = false',('admins = [' + $admins + ']'),('stats_server = ' + $st),'','[master]','enabled = {{MasterEnabled}}','port = {{$MasterPort}}','','[rcon]',('password = ' + (Q '{{$RemoteAdminPassword}}')),'address = \"127.0.0.1\"','','[defaults]','voice = {{VoiceChat}}','text_chat = {{TextChat}}','chat_log = true','votes = {{Votes}}','block_vpn = {{BlockVPN}}','hidden = {{Hidden}}',('password = ' + (Q '{{JoinPassword}}')),'max_players = {{$MaxUsers}}','anti_cheat = \"{{AntiCheat}}\"','','[[server]]',('name = ' + (Q '{{ServerName}}')),'port = {{$GamePort}}') + $pick; [IO.File]::WriteAllLines((Join-Path $b 'dedicated.toml'),[string[]]$t,$u); Write-Host 'dedicated.toml written'"

-c "b='{{$FullBaseDir}}'; cd "$b" || exit 1; mkdir -p game "content/Maps" "content/Game Modes" content/Mods playlists data; [ -f bans.json ] || printf '%s
' '{ "players": [], "ips": [] }' > bans.json; q() { printf '"%s"' "$(printf '%s' "$1" | tr -d '\042\134')"; }; admins=$(printf '%s' '{{Admins}}' | tr ',' '
' | sed -e 's/^ *//' -e 's/ *$//' | grep -E '^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$' | while read -r a; do q "$a"; printf ', '; done | sed 's/, $//'); pl=$(printf '%s' '{{PlaylistFile}}' | sed -e 's/^ *//' -e 's/ *$//'); o=dedicated.toml; printf '%s
' 'game = "game"' 'content = "content"' 'data = "data"' 'bans = "bans.json"' > $o; printf 'public_address = %s
' "$(q '{{PublicAddress}}')" >> $o; printf '%s
' 'upnp = false' 'auto_update = false' >> $o; st=off; [ '{{StatsReporting}}' = 'true' ] && st=''; printf 'admins = [%s]
' "$admins" >> $o; printf 'stats_server = "%s"
' "$st" >> $o; printf '%s
' '' '[master]' 'enabled = {{MasterEnabled}}' 'port = {{$MasterPort}}' '' '[rcon]' >> $o; printf 'password = %s
' "$(q '{{$RemoteAdminPassword}}')" >> $o; printf '%s
' 'address = "127.0.0.1"' '' '[defaults]' 'voice = {{VoiceChat}}' 'text_chat = {{TextChat}}' 'chat_log = true' 'votes = {{Votes}}' 'block_vpn = {{BlockVPN}}' 'hidden = {{Hidden}}' >> $o; printf 'password = %s
' "$(q '{{JoinPassword}}')" >> $o; printf '%s
' 'max_players = {{$MaxUsers}}' 'anti_cheat = "{{AntiCheat}}"' '' '[[server]]' >> $o; printf 'name = %s
' "$(q '{{ServerName}}')" >> $o; printf '%s
' 'port = {{$GamePort}}' >> $o; if [ -n "$pl" ]; then printf 'playlist = %s
' "$(q "$pl")" >> $o; else printf 'map = %s
' "$(q '{{MapName}}')" >> $o; printf 'game = %s
' "$(q '{{GameType}}')" >> $o; fi; echo 'dedicated.toml written'"
